newsitem.title: USA: Six states may join FTC vs Staples merger.
newsitem.headline: Six states may join FTC vs Staples merger.

text.p: Six states considered Friday they may join the federal government's effort to stop the merger of Staples and Office Depot, as the case got its first airing in federal court.
Appearing before Federal District Judge Thomas Hogan, Federal Trade Commission lawyer Melvin Orlans noted that individual states were examining the possibility of entering the case.
Maryland, New York, North Carolina, Pennsyvlania, Virginia and Washington State filed affidavits with the court, seeking documents to help them decide whether to join the suit.
The FTC had gone to court seeking a 10-day temporary restraining order to prevent the two office superstore chains from merging immediately.
Staples and Office Depot deflected the move by promising to remain separate for now and pledged to tell Judge Hogan and the government if they change their minds.
Hogan set another hearing for 9:30 a.m. (1330 GMT) Monday.
